commits.message:
Logging Hardening and Sanitization (#3604)

* security: add log injection protection across codebase (CWE-117)

Implement centralized log sanitization to prevent log injection attacks
as identified in Mend security scan.

Changes:
- Add SecurityValidator.sanitize_log_message() method to strip newlines,
  ANSI escapes, and control characters from user-controlled data in logs
- Apply sanitization to 383 log statements across 22 files covering
  authentication, middleware, routers, and service layers
- Add 24 comprehensive tests in tests/security/test_log_injection_protection.py
- Enhance SECURITY.md with XSS, SSRF, and log injection protection docs

Protected data categories: user emails, session IDs, team IDs,
resource identifiers, error messages, and request parameters.

Refs: Mend Security Report 2026-03-09

commits.message:
Add MCP Plugin Session Reconnection (#3639)

* fix: Add session reconnection logic to MCP external plugin client

Resolves #2796

The MCP external plugin client now implements automatic session recovery
when the remote plugin restarts. This brings feature parity with the Unix
socket client which already has reconnection support.

Changes:
- Add reconnect_attempts and reconnect_delay config fields to MCPClientConfig
- Implement _cleanup_session() to reset session state without full shutdown
- Implement _reconnect_session() with exponential backoff retry logic
- Update invoke_hook() to catch session termination errors and retry once
- Add comprehensive unit tests for reconnection behavior (12 tests)

The reconnection logic:
1. Detects session termination via McpError or PluginError messages
2. Cleans up stale session state
3. Attempts reconnection with exponential backoff
4. Retries the original request once after successful reconnection
5. Re-raises original error if reconnection fails

Tested with both STREAMABLEHTTP and STDIO transports.

Signed-off-by: Mohan Lakshmaiah <mohan.economist@gmail.com>

* style: Fix import ordering in MCP client per isort

Signed-off-by: Mohan Lakshmaiah <mohan.economist@gmail.com>

* fix linting errors

Signed-off-by: Mohan Lakshmaiah <mohan.economist@gmail.com>

* fix: correct STDIO reconnection and improve MCP client reconnect logic

- Fix _cleanup_session() to properly reset STDIO state (task, events,
  error) mirroring shutdown() logic, preventing broken STDIO reconnect
- Move McpError import to module level for cleaner except clause
- Use Python automatic name mangling instead of explicit form
- Fix misleading "exponential backoff" references to "linear backoff"
- Remove AI attribution from test file copyright
- Add tests for STDIO cleanup, reconnect failure, and generic exceptions
- Restore generic except Exception handler for non-MCP errors

  old (1-100) or (5-100) ranges after le= was changed to
  settings.pagination_max_page_size

* fix(tests): use explicit logger names in caplog.at_level to fix CI flakes

LoggingService.initialize() sets root logger to ERROR in CI. Tests using
caplog.at_level(WARNING) without a logger name target the root, which
gets overridden. Specify the exact logger name so caplog sets the level
on the correct logger regardless of root configuration.

Fixes 6 flaky CI failures in test_passthrough_headers,
test_passthrough_headers_fixed, and test_websocket_transport.

* fix(tests): replace sleep-based cache expiry test with time mock

test_cache_expiry used asyncio.sleep(1.1) to wait for a 1s TTL, which
is flaky under CI load. Mock time.time() and advance it deterministically
instead. Also eliminates the 1.1s test runtime.

commits.message:
feat: Rust MCP runtime pre-invoke plugin hooks and WXO auth support (#3705)

* Add pre_tool_hook plugin capability to rust mcp

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* feat: run pre-request plugin hooks on Rust MCP auth path

Extract run_pre_request_hooks() from HttpAuthMiddleware into a shared
function and call it from _run_internal_mcp_authentication() so that
HTTP_PRE_REQUEST plugins (e.g. WXO auth token exchange) fire on the
Rust MCP ingress path, not just the Python middleware chain.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* Support of wxo Plugins and testing

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* docs: document Rust runtime plugin execution and tools/call flow

The two-phase resolve-then-execute model, plugin hook handling by mode,
internal RPC endpoints, and direct execution eligibility criteria were
undocumented. Add coverage across ADR-043, the runtime architecture page,
the plugin framework spec, and the crate README.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* fix: correct two failing tests, clean up diagnostic logging, and document tools_rust

- Fix two failing tests (rustfmt, websocket ping_loop warning filter)
- Replace [DIAG] warning-level diagnostic logs with proper severity levels
  (debug/info/error) across main.py and http_auth_middleware.py
- Remove private _initialized attribute access in middleware logging
- Use module-level uuid import instead of redundant function-level import
  in tool_service.py
- Fix f-string lint in locustfile_echo_delay.py
- Document tools_rust/mcp_runtime in AGENTS.md and llms

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* fix: address Copilot review findings on PR #3705

- Use HttpHookType.HTTP_PRE_REQUEST enum instead of raw string in
  _run_internal_mcp_authentication for type safety and refactor resilience
- Normalize header keys to lowercase in run_pre_request_hooks and
  tool_service pre-invoke header merging to prevent duplicate logical
  headers from casing differences
- Precompute lowercased original header set for auth-override guard
- Pass outbound runtime_headers (not inbound request_headers) to
  pre-invoke hook payload for parity with the Python invoke_tool path
- Validate NUM_TENANTS >= 1 at load test startup
- Fail fast when WXO auth is disabled and no BEARER_TOKEN is set

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* test: add coverage for run_pre_request_hooks and pre-invoke hook execution

Add 15 new tests covering previously untested code paths:

TestRunPreRequestHooks (9 tests):
- No hooks registered returns original headers unchanged
- Plugin-modified headers are merged correctly
- No modification when plugin returns no payload
- Auth header override stripped by default (deny path)
- Auth header override allowed when plugins_can_override_auth_headers=True
- Exception in hook returns original headers safely
- Merged headers normalized to lowercase keys
- GlobalContext created when not provided
- Provided GlobalContext reused

TestRustMcpExecutionPlan (6 tests):
- Post-invoke hooks force fallback (using side_effect for hook type branching)
- Active trace forces fallback
- Pre-invoke only returns eligible plan with hasPreInvokeHooks and modifiedArgs
- Pre-invoke hook can rename tool in plan
- No hook fields in plan when no pre-invoke hooks registered
- Pre-invoke hook receives outbound runtime headers, not inbound request headers

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

* fix: remove duplicate @pytest.mark.asyncio decorator in test_tool_service

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

* fix: auth-header override guard bypass with mixed-case keys

The `overridden` set stored original-case plugin header keys, but the
filter compared lowercased keys against it. A plugin returning
"Authorization" (mixed-case) instead of "authorization" would bypass
the plugins_can_override_auth_headers=false guard and overwrite inbound
auth headers.

Fix: normalize `overridden` to lowercase so the filter comparison is
case-insensitive. Add a deny-path test for mixed-case auth headers.

Also document the known limitation that pre-invoke hooks may run twice
when Rust direct execution fails and falls back to the Python path.
Pre-invoke plugins must be idempotent for correctness on this path.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

* fix: plugin context parity and double pre-invoke on Rust fallback

Two issues addressed:

1. Context parity: prepare_rust_mcp_tool_execution() now accepts
   plugin_global_context and plugin_context_table from the resolve
   handler, reusing the middleware-provided GlobalContext (which carries
   JWT claims state, correlation ID, and user identity). Tool/gateway
   metadata is injected before pre-invoke hooks run, matching the
   invoke_tool() pattern. The resolve handler extracts these from
   request.state and passes them through.

2. Double pre-invoke prevention: When Rust direct execution fails and
   falls back to /_internal/mcp/tools/call, Rust now injects an
   x-contextforge-pre-invoke-ran header. invoke_tool() checks for this
   header and skips re-running TOOL_PRE_INVOKE hooks, preventing double
   execution for non-idempotent plugins (rate limiters, token exchange,
   audit hooks).

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

* fix: prevent external callers from spoofing x-contextforge-pre-invoke-ran

The skip_pre_invoke flag was derived from raw request headers, which
meant any external client could send x-contextforge-pre-invoke-ran:true
to bypass TOOL_PRE_INVOKE security/policy plugins.

Fix: replace header-based derivation with an explicit skip_pre_invoke
parameter threaded through _execute_rpc_tools_call() → invoke_tool().
Only the trusted internal /_internal/mcp/tools/call endpoint (which is
authenticated via shared-secret and not exposed to external clients)
reads the header and sets the flag. The public RPC path never sets it.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

* fix: update test_rpc_tool_invocation for skip_pre_invoke parameter

The mock assertion was missing the new skip_pre_invoke=False kwarg
added to invoke_tool() in the spoofing prevention commit.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
